text.description: The text to display for the breadcrumb.

link.description: The link to use for the breadcrumb.

route.description: The route of for this breadcrumb. Dynamic variables should be wrapped in `{`.  Such as `{{id}}`.

params.description:
The params for the route. Dynamic variables in the route should have a corresponding value in params.
Example:
```
 route: "/users/{{id}}""
 params: {"id:"" 1}
```
